quizName:
Hardest Questions in Connecticut
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop to rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, stop to rest or change drivers. Tiredness slows your thinking and your reaction time, which makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic rules they must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: If you need to stop suddenly on an interstate highway, what should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn to get other drivers' attention.
Get out and wave at the next car that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your car.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on the shoulder of an interstate, turn on your emergency flashers and stay inside your vehicle if you can. Standing or walking on an interstate is very dangerous because of fast-moving traffic.

questions.question: A traffic light is green, but a police officer signals you to stop. What should you do?

options.text: Do what the car in front of you does.

questions.explanation: You must always obey a police officer's commands, even if they contradict traffic signals or signs.

questions.question: You just had an argument with someone and you are angry. What should you do?

options.text: Play loud music so you won't think about the argument.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Drive on the interstate to calm down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect how well you drive. If you are angry, upset, or worried, calm down before driving. You need to focus on the road without thinking about what made you upset.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic rules. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers that people on bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to use your brakes to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around at this location to go in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What type of road condition does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to what is coming up ahead. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: In a vehicle with airbags, where should children age 12 and under sit?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can hurt children. Any child age 12 or under should sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights?

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, then go when the gates are raised.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop well behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, then go when the gates are raised.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when signs, warning devices, or flaggers warn you of a train. You cannot drive around lowered gates. It is illegal.

questions.question: At a crosswalk, what should you do?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right to cross at a crosswalk. You must stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk, whether it is marked or unmarked.

questions.question: If you see an aggressive driver, what should you do?
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to let an aggressive driver pass. Do not compete with other drivers. Always stay calm and focus on your own safe driving.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop at a rest stop or service area if you feel tired. Take a nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not a safe substitute for rest and can be dangerous.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert and watch for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon join into one lane.

questions.question: Drowsiness can affect your driving just like alcohol and drugs. What does it do?
questions.explanation: Not getting enough sleep causes poor driving. Drowsiness slows your reaction time, reduces your awareness, and affects your judgment — just like alcohol and drugs do.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle is coming toward you with flashing lights and a siren. What should you do?

options.text: Move to the right and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: You must let emergency vehicles pass. When you see or hear a police car, fire truck, or ambulance with lights or sirens, pull to the right side of the road and stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up.
